verification_policy.meaning: Structural inventory/state checks are not proof of engineering behavior, external interoperability or standards conformance.
verification_policy.cargo: Use scripts/run_cargo_guarded.py --workload proof for authorized Rust proof.
verification_policy.closure: Future fixes retain issue-linked landing, focused behavioral evidence and actual independent review; this audit record is not a PASS receipt.
verification_policy.no_new_gate: No global audit-ID/string/digest gate added. Extend existing behavioral test owners as each fix is authorized.

findings.title: Emit protocol-conforming MCP tool results and execution errors
findings.observation: Production stdio host emits content blocks with type=json for success and execution errors. JSON belongs in structuredContent and/or serialized text; execution errors need appropriate MCP error signaling.
findings.impact: Strict standard clients may reject results; portable agent integration is not established by internal envelope tests.

evidence.method: Executed production StdioToolHost.run_stdio with existing FakeDaemonClient, negotiated protocol 2025-06-18, called datum.query.board_summary.
evidence.result: Observed content[0].type=json; allowed-content-tag check rejected json.
evidence.limits: No actual vendor client or physical design was exercised.

verification.existing_entry_point: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=mcp-server python3 -m unittest test_stdio_broker test_protocol_catalog
verification.what_it_does_not_establish: Existing tests do not independently validate successful/error tool-result shapes against negotiated MCP. Add behavior assertions and real-client round trips during authorized repair.

findings.title: Implement semantic answers behind named revision queries
findings.observation: After validating the query name, query_revision_authority routes every resolved query to query_snapshot, which returns the same records/events. release_readiness, evidence_freshness, impact_path and adapter_status have no query-specific evaluation. RevisionQueryRequest also lacks subject-specific selectors.
findings.impact: Users and agents cannot rely on the engine to answer the engineering question named by the interface; an inventory is not executable semantic parity.

evidence.method: Source control-flow review of engine, native facade, CLI and daemon.
evidence.result: Known query names share one snapshot implementation; public CLI exposes catalog/query.
evidence.limits: Underlying typed revision evaluators and records exist; no claim that all revision machinery is absent.

verification.existing_entry_point: python3 scripts/run_cargo_guarded.py --workload proof -- cargo test -p eda-engine revision::public_service::tests --locked --offline
verification.what_it_does_not_establish: Current tests primarily cover inventory and unmanaged/stale behavior; need managed query-specific results and explicit unsupported states.

verification.existing_entry_point: python3 scripts/run_cargo_guarded.py --workload proof -- cargo test -p datum-eda-cli commands::revision --locked --offline
verification.what_it_does_not_establish: Catalog/serialization parity alone does not establish semantic answers.

findings.title: Preserve distinct observations across converging impact paths
findings.observation: evaluate_subject marks nodes visited once while queue entries also carry changed-observation sets. A later path with additional observations is discarded.
findings.impact: An affected downstream document/evidence consumer can be reported Unaffected, contrary to witness-qualified impact semantics.

evidence.method: Source review and bounded Python transcription of the traversal.

reproduction.visit_order: A then B; M reached first with geometry

evidence.result: Transcription returns Unaffected for DOC; B -> M -> DOC requires Affected.
evidence.limits: Rust function was not executed. Located callers are tests; no integrated GUI release corruption demonstrated.

verification.existing_entry_point: python3 scripts/run_cargo_guarded.py --workload proof -- cargo test -p eda-engine revision::impact_tests --locked --offline
verification.what_it_does_not_establish: Existing simple-chain tests omit multiple deltas/convergent paths. Repair needs convergence and cycle cases with valid graph fixtures.

findings.title: Separate probe transport evidence from real agent interoperability proof
findings.observation: Named adapter workflow test passes a generated probe as --binary for each vendor name. The fake agent client reads the same custom json block produced by the broker.
findings.impact: This establishes useful Datum transport/plumbing behavior but cannot establish actual vendor configuration, instruction discovery, protocol validation, authentication or resume behavior.

evidence.method: Retained runner, Rust test and probe source inspection.
evidence.result: Vendor adapter names are exercised using a stand-in executable.
evidence.limits: Preserve unrelated terminal proof and historical owner acceptance; this record neither reopens the terminal epic nor invalidates every terminal claim.

verification.what_it_does_not_establish: Current runner uses probes. Real installed/version-pinned clients need separate ordinary workflow evidence in an isolated owned environment; authorization/auth prerequisites remain explicit.

findings.observation: Board tool gate permits Select and available Move. Track/via/zone native CLI/MCP authoring exists; full graphical editing remains explicitly pending.
findings.impact: Core board workflows cannot yet be completed through the intended manual graphical editor, despite automation coverage.

evidence.limits: Native schematic authoring uses separate implemented paths; this does not claim all authoring tools are absent.

verification.what_it_does_not_establish: Needs direct manual create/edit/delete, journal/history and save/reopen proof; CLI-only mutation and handoff tests are insufficient. No new GUI campaign authorized by this intake.

findings.title: Close schematic to PCB engineering revision and hierarchy workflow
findings.observation: Initial transfer refuses stale Part bindings, leaves existing physical counterparts unchanged and supports the bounded root occurrence. ECO/synchronization/repeated hierarchy are excluded from delivered initial transfer.
findings.impact: Initial capture/transfer does not yet support the complete change-existing-design workflow needed for long-lived professional designs.

evidence.method: Transfer planner, composed operation batch and closed task boundary review.
evidence.result: Existing counterpart is retained rather than updated.
evidence.limits: The accepted bounded initial-transfer delivery remains closed and credited; no reopening or expanded acceptance bar.

findings.observation: Behavioral model attachments and content-addressed storage exist; executable schematic simulation/probing/result invalidation and SPICE-netlist export were not established.

findings.title: Reconcile advanced routing ambition with current contract exclusions
findings.observation: Diff-pair/length matching/impedance are deferred; push-and-shove and interactive width-from-rules are explicitly out of the current PCB contract scope. Current rules lack the advanced constraint types and evaluate only basic scope leaves.
findings.impact: Delivering the current bounded routing contract alone cannot establish the broader advanced trace manipulation/routing ambition.

evidence.result: Deterministic route proposals/revalidation exist; advanced interactive/high-speed scope remains future.
evidence.limits: Deferrals/exclusions are not runtime bugs. This is a scope question, not ratification, implementation grant or automatic successor.

findings.impact: A standards registry or completed specification cannot establish standards-compliant generated documentation. IEEE315 wording must not silently replace the existing ratified IEC selection.

evidence.method: Standard-adoption doctrine and support dispositions reviewed.
evidence.result: Design-only boundary and selected IEC symbology preserved.
evidence.limits: No new standards selection, compliance judgment, licensed-source access, or implementation authorization. Closed drafting specification task remains closed.
